Start an adaptive test

Source: R/fct_cat.R
cat_start.Rd

Starts a computerized adaptive test (CAT) over the chosen scales of an item bank, one scale at a time, in the order given. Within a scale, each next item is the most informative one left (next_item_rsm); after each answer the ability is estimated again by EAP (eap_est_rsm), with the normal prior of the scale, over a grid of \(\pm 6\) prior standard deviations. A scale stops when the standard error, divided by the prior standard deviation, is at most se_threshold, or when its items run out; the test then moves to the next scale.

cat_start(bank, scales = unique(bank$scale), se_threshold = 0.45)

Arguments

bank

An item bank read with read_item_bank.

scales

The scales to test, in order.

se_threshold

Standardized standard error at which a scale stops.

Value

A CAT session: a list to pass to cat_answer, cat_item and cat_results. Its stage is "testing" until the last scale stops, then "done"; progress has one row per scale and log one row per answer.

Details

Abilities and standard errors are reported standardized per scale (divided by the prior standard deviation), so the same threshold is the same target in every scale: a threshold se aims at a reliability of about \(1 - se^2\).

See also

Other CAT session: cat_answer(), cat_item(), cat_results()

Examples

q <- ipip50()
s <- cat_start(q$bank, scales = "Extraversion", se_threshold = 0.45)
while (s$stage == "testing") s <- cat_answer(s, 4) # always "Moderately accurate"
cat_results(s)
#>          scale     theta        se percentile answered total    status
#> 1 Extraversion 0.3236773 0.4318709   62.69088        4    10 completed
s$log
#>   step        scale                                        question answer
#> 1    1 Extraversion I Talk to a lot of different people at parties.      4
#> 2    2 Extraversion                    I Am quiet around strangers.      4
#> 3    3 Extraversion                     I Am the life of the party.      4
#> 4    4 Extraversion       I Don't like to draw attention to myself.      4
#>       theta        se
#> 1 0.5714096 0.7170862
#> 2 0.2657205 0.5712175
#> 3 0.5382870 0.4896811
#> 4 0.3236773 0.4318709
